title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech
abstract: arXiv:2609.16906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counterspeech (CS) - direct responses that counter online Hate Speech (HS) using reasoning and alternative viewpoints - has emerged as an alternative to content removal. Current automatic CS generation methods, however, frequently produce generic, ineffective replies that fail to target the implicit stereotypes behind HS. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into Large Language Models prompts. We validate our approach on a novel, human-curated dataset annotated in English, Italian, and Spanish. Extensive evaluations show that stereotype-conditioned prompting substantially outperforms generic baselines across all three languages, obtaining significant gains in factuality, specificity, cogency, and effectiveness for both explicit and implicit implied stereotypes.

translated_title: 解构刻板印象：面向有效多语言反仇恨言论的范围条件生成方法
translated_abstract: 反言论——即运用推理和替代性观点直接回应网络仇恨言论——已成为内容删除的一种替代方案。然而，当前的自动反言论生成方法往往产生泛化且无效的回复，未能针对仇恨言论背后的隐性刻板印象。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了一种新颖的范围条件生成框架，将结构化的刻板印象特征显式地整合到大语言模型的提示中。我们在一个新颖的、人工整理的多语言数据集上验证了该方法，该数据集以英语、意大利语和西班牙语进行标注。广泛的评估表明，刻板印象条件提示在所有三种语言上均显著优于通用基线方法，在事实性、针对性、说服力和有效性方面均取得了显著提升，对于显性和隐性刻板印象均有效。
tldr: 本文提出一种范围条件生成框架，通过将结构化刻板印象特征显式融入大语言模型提示，在英语、意大利语和西班牙语上生成更真实、更具针对性和更有效的反仇恨言论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into LLM prompts, substantially improving the factuality, specificity, and effectiveness of multilingual counterspeech generation across English, Italian, and Spanish.
